[SWS_DM_01103] Caching of RestartOperationCycle
⌈
If the function
ara::diag::OperationCycle::RestartOperationCycle is called and the DM
is currently not ready to process the reported restart of the operation cycle, the
DM shall cache one reported operation cycle restart and evaluate it when the con-
nection to the DM is (re-)established.
⌋
